column3: Until the editor chunk lands the composer shows a plain textarea with the placeholder that is a full editor handle: Enter and Send submit from it, and its text, caret and selection carry into the Token Input on upgrade. A composition in progress defers the swap to compositionend. A failed editor load throws into an ErrorBoundary that shows Stopped with Try again, which reloads the chunk and refocuses the editor (components/composer/editor.tsx)
column4: Solid sets placeholder as a property on the un-upgraded custom element, so the :not(:defined) attr(placeholder) rule was empty and keys typed before the upgrade were dropped. A rejected loadUiSdk("editor") left no textbox and no error. The boundary follows lazyView and #89. Setting attr:placeholder alone would still drop early typing
column5: e2e: an aborted @ui-sdk_web_token-input.js shows the alert, and Try again leaves a focused textbox that sends; with the chunk held, the placeholder shows, a selection at 2-4 survives the upgrade, a CDP composition started before it commits as 日本 only, and Send (attachment only) and Enter each send once before it. Removing the deferral, the selection restore or the refocus each fails its test
